definition.zh-TW: 從進貨到賣出再到收回現金，平均要經過幾天，等於平均銷貨日數加平均收現日數。天數越短表示生意轉得越快。
definition.en: The average number of days from buying stock to selling it and collecting the cash: days inventory plus days sales outstanding. A shorter cycle means the business turns over faster.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
